title: Apple Pay set to launch in India with Axis Bank today, sources say | TechCrunch
summary: Earlier this month, Reuters reported that Apple was preparing to launch Apple Pay in India in October, starting with Axis Bank credit cards. Even if Apple Pay remains a niche service, the economics could still make India meaningful for Apple.
